scenes.text: It was a normal day for Leo. He opened his furniture shop, straightened the display, and waited. People hurried past. One checked their phone. Another glanced at the window and kept walking. Days went by, but the shop stayed quiet. Leo had data everywhere, yet he still couldn't tell who to reach or what to offer.
